title: August ’26 Product Release: Factory Energy Data From the Carbonfact Suppliers Network
summary: Get primary energy data from your factories without running a data collection campaign.
body_markdown:
The


[Carbonfact Suppliers Network](https://suppliers.carbonfact.com/)


i


s a fast and secure way for brands, factories, and innovative suppliers to exchange environmental data.


Instead of each brand requesting data separately, suppliers manage their information in one place and control access, and the same data can be reused without any additional work.


The platform is free for both brands and suppliers


**.**


It’s designed for two purposes:


**1. Factory energy data exchange** **2. Innovative materials/processes discovery**


Factories centrally share energy and heat data, which flows directly into your LCAs on your Carbonfact platform. When two brands share a factory, the data only needs to be collected once.


**Jump down to the feature announcement.**


Suppliers share LCA-based impact data. Carbonfact ensures comparability, and the data flows directly into the LCAs on your Carbonfact platform, making it usable in modeling tools.


**[Read more about this here](https://www.carbonfact.com/blog/platform/carbonfact-for-suppliers) .**


## Announcing: Factory Energy Data Exchange


Factories in the network share their electricity and heat consumption, by source and per year. When a factory or supplier shares data on Carbonfact, that data does not need to be requested and processed separately by every brand working with that factory. If multiple brands use the same factory or material supplier, energy data is shared between brands, reducing work for everyone.


This enables a form of collective sustainability data intelligence: less duplication, faster access to primary data, and a common foundation for impact measurement and decarbonization – while keeping full confidentiality.


Here’s what’s new:


1. Factory Energy Data flows directly into your platform


2. Invite your factories directly from the platform


3. Contribute your existing data to the platform
